card.name: Literary quotation and philosophy passages
card.fires_on: Small words and punctuation inside discussion of famous literary works (T.S. Eliot's The Waste Land, Tennyson's In Memoriam) and Peirce's sign theory. It fires on the words right around titles and technical terms, not on the terms themselves.
